 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",

   "source": [
    "# Bundesliga 2001–2026 End-to-End AI Project\n",
    "\n",
    "**25년 경기 분석 · 누수 없는 경기 결과 예측 · PyTorch 딥러닝 · SHAP · 선수 BIS · 선수 유형 · 오토인코더 유사 선수**\n",
    "\n",
    "이 노트북은 VS Code에서 위에서 아래로 `Run All` 할 수 있게 구성했습니다.\n",
    "\n",
    "프로젝트는 두 갈래로 분리합니다.\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **실제 정답이 있는 경기 결과 예측**: 머신러닝 → 딥러닝 → SHAP\n",
    "2. **실제 정답 라벨이 없는 선수 스카우팅**: 투명한 포지션별 BIS → 군집화 → 딥러닝 오토인코더\n",
    "\n",
    "> BIS 공식을 다시 예측하는 모델은 만들지 않습니다. 그런 모델은 사람이 만든 공식을 그대로 복제할 뿐이기 때문입니다. SHAP은 실제 경기 결과 모델에 적용합니다.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 실행 방법 — 외부 CSV 불필요\n",
    "\n",
    "이 노트북에는 검증된 경기 데이터와 선수 데이터가 압축되어 들어 있습니다.\n",
    "\n",
    "1. 이 `.ipynb` 파일 하나만 VS Code에서 엽니다.\n",
    "2. 오른쪽 위 `Select Kernel`에서 Python 커널을 선택합니다.\n",
    "3. `Run All`을 누릅니다.\n",
    "\n",
    "외부 CSV의 파일명·경로·내용을 읽지 않으므로 기존 폴더의 잘못된 CSV는 삭제하지 않아도 됩니다.\n",
    "실행 시 내장 데이터의 SHA-256 무결성을 확인한 뒤 메모리에서 불러옵니다.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [

    "    \"torch\": \"torch\",\n",

    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "missing = [pip_name for module, pip_name in REQUIREMENTS.items() if importlib.util.find_spec(module) is None]\n",
    "if missing:\n",
    "    print(\"설치할 패키지:\", missing)\n",

    "else:\n",
    "    print(\"필수 패키지가 이미 설치되어 있습니다.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Python:\", sys.version)\n",
    "print(\"설치에 문제가 있으면 https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/ 에서 운영체제에 맞는 명령을 확인하세요.\")\n"
   ]

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. 내장 데이터 무결성 검사 및 자동 복원\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# 이 셀은 외부 CSV를 읽지 않습니다. 노트북 내부의 압축 데이터를 복원합니다.\n",
    "import base64\n",
    "import gzip\n",
    "import hashlib\n",
    "import io\n",
    "\n",
    "MATCHES_PAYLOAD = \"\"\n",
    "PLAYERS_PAYLOAD = \"\"\n",
    "MATCHES_SHA256 = \"77eeb9f1f0b1a18aefa5d9fd8538495b7a2266e842cbb4e17e3680266239f59f\"\n",
    "PLAYERS_SHA256 = \"e408757b54d26a7f5abeae451f43686cce96c8914b50416a2dd3f9d0d36b34c0\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def read_embedded_csv(encoded, expected_sha256, parse_dates=None):\n",
    "    raw = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded.encode(\"ascii\")))\n",
    "    actual_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()\n",
    "    if actual_sha256 != expected_sha256:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(\"노트북 내장 데이터 무결성 검사 실패\")\n",
    "    return pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(raw), parse_dates=parse_dates, low_memory=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "matches = read_embedded_csv(MATCHES_PAYLOAD, MATCHES_SHA256, parse_dates=[\"match_date\"])\n",
    "players = read_embedded_csv(PLAYERS_PAYLOAD, PLAYERS_SHA256)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 한 경기를 홈팀·원정팀 관점의 2행으로 변환합니다.\n",
    "home_view = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"match_id\": matches[\"match_id\"],\n",
    "    \"season\": matches[\"season\"],\n",
    "    \"season_start_year\": matches[\"season_start_year\"],\n",
    "    \"match_date\": matches[\"match_date\"],\n",
    "    \"team\": matches[\"home_team\"],\n",
    "    \"opponent\": matches[\"away_team\"],\n",
    "    \"venue\": \"Home\",\n",
    "    \"goals_for\": matches[\"home_goals\"],\n",
    "    \"goals_against\": matches[\"away_goals\"],\n",
    "    \"result\": matches[\"result_code\"].map({\"H\": \"W\", \"D\": \"D\", \"A\": \"L\"}),\n",
    "    \"points\": matches[\"home_points\"],\n",
    "})\n",
    "away_view = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"match_id\": matches[\"match_id\"],\n",
    "    \"season\": matches[\"season\"],\n",
    "    \"season_start_year\": matches[\"season_start_year\"],\n",
    "    \"match_date\": matches[\"match_date\"],\n",
    "    \"team\": matches[\"away_team\"],\n",
    "    \"opponent\": matches[\"home_team\"],\n",
    "    \"venue\": \"Away\",\n",
    "    \"goals_for\": matches[\"away_goals\"],\n",
    "    \"goals_against\": matches[\"home_goals\"],\n",
    "    \"result\": matches[\"result_code\"].map({\"H\": \"L\", \"D\": \"D\", \"A\": \"W\"}),\n",
    "    \"points\": matches[\"away_points\"],\n",
    "})\n",
    "team_matches = pd.concat([home_view, away_view], ignore_index=True)\n",
    "team_matches[\"goal_difference\"] = team_matches[\"goals_for\"] - team_matches[\"goals_against\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "# 팀-시즌 요약도 내장 경기 데이터에서 다시 계산합니다.\n",
    "team_seasons = (\n",
    "    team_matches.groupby([\"season\", \"season_start_year\", \"team\"], as_index=False)\n",
    "    .agg(\n",
    "        matches=(\"match_id\", \"count\"),\n",
    "        wins=(\"result\", lambda s: int((s == \"W\").sum())),\n",
    "        draws=(\"result\", lambda s: int((s == \"D\").sum())),\n",
    "        losses=(\"result\", lambda s: int((s == \"L\").sum())),\n",
    "        goals_for=(\"goals_for\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        goals_against=(\"goals_against\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        points=(\"points\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")\n",
    "team_seasons[\"goal_difference\"] = team_seasons[\"goals_for\"] - team_seasons[\"goals_against\"]\n",
    "team_seasons = team_seasons.sort_values(\n",
    "    [\"season_start_year\", \"points\", \"goal_difference\", \"goals_for\", \"team\"],\n",
    "    ascending=[True, False, False, False, True],\n",
    ").reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "team_seasons[\"calculated_rank\"] = team_seasons.groupby(\"season\").cumcount() + 1\n",
    "\n",
    "# 900분 이상 선수 파일도 선수 원본에서 자동 생성합니다.\n",
    "players_900 = players.loc[pd.to_numeric(players[\"minutes\"], errors=\"coerce\").ge(900)].copy().reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"내장 데이터 복원 및 무결성 검사 완료\")\n",
    "print(\"경기:\", matches.shape, \"| 팀 관점:\", team_matches.shape, \"| 팀-시즌:\", team_seasons.shape)\n",
    "print(\"선수:\", players.shape, \"| 900분 이상 선수:\", players_900.shape)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "overview = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"dataset\": [\"matches\", \"team_matches\", \"team_seasons\", \"players\", \"players_900\"],\n",
    "    \"rows\": [len(matches), len(team_matches), len(team_seasons), len(players), len(players_900)],\n",
    "    \"columns\": [matches.shape[1], team_matches.shape[1], team_seasons.shape[1], players.shape[1], players_900.shape[1]],\n",
    "})\n",
    "display(overview)\n",
    "display(matches.head(3))\n",
    "display(players_900[[\"player\", \"club\", \"primary_position\", \"minutes\", \"goals\", \"assists\"]].head(10))\n"
   ]

   "cell_type": "code",

   "metadata": {},

   "source": [
    "# 실행을 중단해야 하는 핵심 품질검사\n",
    "qa = {\n",
    "    \"경기 수\": len(matches),\n",
    "    \"시즌 수\": matches[\"season\"].nunique(),\n",
    "    \"경기 ID 중복\": int(matches[\"match_id\"].duplicated().sum()),\n",
    "    \"날짜 누락\": int(matches[\"match_date\"].isna().sum()),\n",
    "    \"잘못된 결과 코드\": int((~matches[\"result_code\"].isin([\"H\", \"D\", \"A\"])).sum()),\n",
    "    \"팀 관점 행/경기 비율\": len(team_matches) / len(matches),\n",
    "    \"선수-구단 ID 중복\": int(players[\"player_club_id\"].duplicated().sum()),\n",
    "    \"900분 이상 선수\": int(players[\"ranking_eligible_900min\"].sum()),\n",
    "}\n",
    "display(pd.DataFrame(qa.items(), columns=[\"검사항목\", \"값\"]))\n",
    "\n",
    "assert len(matches) == 7650\n",
    "assert matches[\"season\"].nunique() == 25\n",
    "assert matches[\"match_id\"].is_unique\n",
    "assert matches[\"match_date\"].notna().all()\n",
    "assert matches[\"result_code\"].isin([\"H\", \"D\", \"A\"]).all()\n",
    "assert len(team_matches) == len(matches) * 2\n",
    "assert players[\"player_club_id\"].is_unique\n",
    "print(\"핵심 품질검사 통과\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {

   "source": [
    "## 2. 25년 경기 및 구단 EDA\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},

    "season_eda = (\n",

    "    .agg(\n",
    "        matches=(\"match_id\", \"count\"),\n",
    "        goals=(\"total_goals\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "        home_wins=(\"result_code\", lambda s: (s == \"H\").sum()),\n",
    "        draws=(\"result_code\", lambda s: (s == \"D\").sum()),\n",

    "season_eda[\"goals_per_match\"] = season_eda[\"goals\"] / season_eda[\"matches\"]\n",
    "season_eda[\"home_win_rate\"] = season_eda[\"home_wins\"] / season_eda[\"matches\"]\n",
    "season_eda[\"draw_rate\"] = season_eda[\"draws\"] / season_eda[\"matches\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 5))\n",
    "sns.lineplot(data=season_eda, x=\"season_start_year\", y=\"goals_per_match\", marker=\"o\", ax=axes[0], color=\"#D20515\")\n",

    "axes[1].set(title=\"Home Win Rate\", xlabel=\"Season start year\", ylabel=\"Rate\")\n",
    "axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda x, pos: f\"{x:.0%}\")\n",

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. 경기 시작 전 피처 생성\n",
    "\n",
    "아래 모델의 목표는 `홈승 / 무승부 / 원정승` 3개 클래스입니다.\n",
    "\n",
    "사용하지 않는 변수:\n",
    "\n",
    "- 해당 경기의 득점\n",
    "- 해당 경기의 슈팅·유효슈팅·카드·코너\n",
    "- 해당 경기 결과로 계산된 누적값\n",
    "\n",
    "사용하는 변수는 경기 직전 시점의 Elo, 최근 5경기 폼, 시즌 누적 성적, 휴식일입니다. 시간순으로 한 경기씩 처리한 뒤 결과를 업데이트하므로 현재 경기 정답이 피처에 들어가지 않습니다.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def _new_team_state():\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"elo\": 1500.0,\n",
    "        \"form_points\": deque(maxlen=5),\n",
    "        \"form_gd\": deque(maxlen=5),\n",
    "        \"season_gp\": 0,\n",
    "        \"season_points\": 0,\n",
    "        \"season_gf\": 0,\n",
    "        \"season_ga\": 0,\n",
    "        \"last_date\": None,\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "def _mean_or(values, default):\n",
    "    return float(np.mean(values)) if len(values) else float(default)\n",
    "\n",
    "def build_pre_match_features(match_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:\n",
    "    ordered = match_df.sort_values([\"season_start_year\", \"match_date\", \"match_id\"]).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "    states = defaultdict(_new_team_state)\n",
    "    rows = []\n",
    "    active_season = None\n",
    "\n",
    "    for row in ordered.itertuples(index=False):\n",
    "        if row.season != active_season:\n",
    "            # 새 시즌: Elo는 평균으로 25% 회귀, 시즌 폼과 누적값은 초기화\n",
    "            for state in states.values():\n",
    "                state[\"elo\"] = 1500.0 + 0.75 * (state[\"elo\"] - 1500.0)\n",
    "                state[\"form_points\"].clear()\n",
    "                state[\"form_gd\"].clear()\n",
    "                state[\"season_gp\"] = 0\n",
    "                state[\"season_points\"] = 0\n",
    "                state[\"season_gf\"] = 0\n",
    "                state[\"season_ga\"] = 0\n",
    "            active_season = row.season\n",
    "\n",
    "        h = states[row.home_team]\n",
    "        a = states[row.away_team]\n",
    "        h_gp, a_gp = h[\"season_gp\"], a[\"season_gp\"]\n",
    "        h_rest = min((row.match_date - h[\"last_date\"]).days, 30) if h[\"last_date\"] is not None else 7\n",
    "        a_rest = min((row.match_date - a[\"last_date\"]).days, 30) if a[\"last_date\"] is not None else 7\n",
    "\n",
    "        feature_row = {\n",
    "            \"match_id\": row.match_id,\n",
    "            \"season\": row.season,\n",
    "            \"season_start_year\": row.season_start_year,\n",
    "            \"match_date\": row.match_date,\n",
    "            \"home_team\": row.home_team,\n",
    "            \"away_team\": row.away_team,\n",
    "            \"home_elo_pre\": h[\"elo\"],\n",
    "            \"away_elo_pre\": a[\"elo\"],\n",
    "            \"elo_diff_pre\": h[\"elo\"] - a[\"elo\"],\n",
    "            \"home_form_ppg5_pre\": _mean_or(h[\"form_points\"], 1.0),\n",
    "            \"away_form_ppg5_pre\": _mean_or(a[\"form_points\"], 1.0),\n",
    "            \"home_form_gd5_pre\": _mean_or(h[\"form_gd\"], 0.0),\n",
    "            \"away_form_gd5_pre\": _mean_or(a[\"form_gd\"], 0.0),\n",
    "            \"home_season_ppg_pre\": h[\"season_points\"] / h_gp if h_gp else 1.0,\n",
    "            \"away_season_ppg_pre\": a[\"season_points\"] / a_gp if a_gp else 1.0,\n",
    "            \"home_season_gf_pg_pre\": h[\"season_gf\"] / h_gp if h_gp else 1.2,\n",
    "            \"away_season_gf_pg_pre\": a[\"season_gf\"] / a_gp if a_gp else 1.2,\n",
    "            \"home_season_ga_pg_pre\": h[\"season_ga\"] / h_gp if h_gp else 1.2,\n",
    "            \"away_season_ga_pg_pre\": a[\"season_ga\"] / a_gp if a_gp else 1.2,\n",
    "            \"home_games_played_pre\": h_gp,\n",
    "            \"away_games_played_pre\": a_gp,\n",
    "            \"home_rest_days\": h_rest,\n",
    "            \"away_rest_days\": a_rest,\n",
    "            \"form_ppg_diff_pre\": _mean_or(h[\"form_points\"], 1.0) - _mean_or(a[\"form_points\"], 1.0),\n",
    "            \"season_ppg_diff_pre\": (h[\"season_points\"] / h_gp if h_gp else 1.0) - (a[\"season_points\"] / a_gp if a_gp else 1.0),\n",
    "            \"target_code\": {\"A\": 0, \"D\": 1, \"H\": 2}[row.result_code],\n",
    "            \"target_label\": {\"A\": \"Away Win\", \"D\": \"Draw\", \"H\": \"Home Win\"}[row.result_code],\n",
    "        }\n",
    "        rows.append(feature_row)\n",
    "\n",
    "        # 경기 종료 후에만 상태 업데이트\n",
    "        if row.result_code == \"H\":\n",
    "            h_points, a_points, actual_home = 3, 0, 1.0\n",
    "        elif row.result_code == \"A\":\n",
    "            h_points, a_points, actual_home = 0, 3, 0.0\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            h_points, a_points, actual_home = 1, 1, 0.5\n",
    "\n",
    "        expected_home = 1.0 / (1.0 + 10 ** ((a[\"elo\"] - (h[\"elo\"] + 65.0)) / 400.0))\n",
    "        margin = abs(int(row.home_goals) - int(row.away_goals))\n",
    "        k = 20.0 * (1.0 + 0.10 * min(margin, 4))\n",
    "        delta = k * (actual_home - expected_home)\n",
    "        h[\"elo\"] += delta\n",
    "        a[\"elo\"] -= delta\n",
    "\n",
    "        goal_diff = int(row.home_goals) - int(row.away_goals)\n",
    "        h[\"form_points\"].append(h_points)\n",
    "        a[\"form_points\"].append(a_points)\n",
    "        h[\"form_gd\"].append(goal_diff)\n",
    "        a[\"form_gd\"].append(-goal_diff)\n",
    "        for state, points, gf, ga in [\n",
    "            (h, h_points, int(row.home_goals), int(row.away_goals)),\n",
    "            (a, a_points, int(row.away_goals), int(row.home_goals)),\n",
    "        ]:\n",
    "            state[\"season_gp\"] += 1\n",
    "            state[\"season_points\"] += points\n",
    "            state[\"season_gf\"] += gf\n",
    "            state[\"season_ga\"] += ga\n",
    "            state[\"last_date\"] = row.match_date\n",
    "\n",
    "    return pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "\n",
    "model_df = build_pre_match_features(matches)\n",
    "display(model_df.head())\n",
    "print(\"모델링 행 수:\", len(model_df))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# 시간 순서 분리: 과거로 학습하고 미래 시즌으로만 검증/테스트\n",
    "train_df = model_df[model_df[\"season_start_year\"] <= 2022].copy()\n",
    "val_df = model_df[model_df[\"season_start_year\"] == 2023].copy()\n",
    "test_df = model_df[model_df[\"season_start_year\"] >= 2024].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "split_summary = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "    \"split\": [\"train\", \"validation\", \"test\"],\n",
    "    \"seasons\": [\n",
    "        f\"{train_df.season.min()} ~ {train_df.season.max()}\",\n",
    "        f\"{val_df.season.min()} ~ {val_df.season.max()}\",\n",
    "        f\"{test_df.season.min()} ~ {test_df.season.max()}\",\n",
    "    ],\n",
    "    \"rows\": [len(train_df), len(val_df), len(test_df)],\n",
    "})\n",
    "display(split_summary)\n",
    "\n",
    "target_col = \"target_code\"\n",
    "categorical_features = [\"home_team\", \"away_team\"]\n",
    "excluded = {\"match_id\", \"season\", \"match_date\", \"target_code\", \"target_label\"}\n",
    "numeric_features = [c for c in model_df.columns if c not in excluded | set(categorical_features)]\n",
    "\n",
    "X_train = train_df[categorical_features + numeric_features]\n",
    "y_train = train_df[target_col].to_numpy()\n",
    "X_val = val_df[categorical_features + numeric_features]\n",
    "y_val = val_df[target_col].to_numpy()\n",
    "X_test = test_df[categorical_features + numeric_features]\n",
    "y_test = test_df[target_col].to_numpy()\n",
    "CLASS_NAMES = np.array([\"Away Win\", \"Draw\", \"Home Win\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "display(pd.Series(y_train).map(dict(enumerate(CLASS_NAMES))).value_counts(normalize=True).rename(\"train_rate\"))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "categorical_pipe = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=\"ignore\", sparse_output=False)\n",
    "numeric_pipe = Pipeline([\n",
    "    (\"imputer\", SimpleImputer(strategy=\"median\")),\n",
    "    (\"scaler\", StandardScaler()),\n",
    "])\n",
    "preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([\n",
    "    (\"teams\", categorical_pipe, categorical_features),\n",
    "    (\"numeric\", numeric_pipe, numeric_features),\n",
    "], sparse_threshold=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "X_train_t = np.asarray(preprocessor.fit_transform(X_train), dtype=np.float32)\n",
    "X_val_t = np.asarray(preprocessor.transform(X_val), dtype=np.float32)\n",
    "X_test_t = np.asarray(preprocessor.transform(X_test), dtype=np.float32)\n",
    "feature_names = np.asarray(preprocessor.get_feature_names_out())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"변환 후 크기:\", X_train_t.shape, X_val_t.shape, X_test_t.shape)\n",
    "print(\"피처 예시:\", feature_names[:15].tolist())\n",
    "joblib.dump(preprocessor, MODEL_DIR / \"match_preprocessor.joblib\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 5. 머신러닝 베이스라인 비교\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def evaluate_predictions(y_true, pred, proba, model_name, split):\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"model\": model_name,\n",
    "        \"split\": split,\n",
    "        \"accuracy\": accuracy_score(y_true, pred),\n",
    "        \"balanced_accuracy\": balanced_accuracy_score(y_true, pred),\n",
    "        \"macro_f1\": f1_score(y_true, pred, average=\"macro\"),\n",
    "        \"log_loss\": log_loss(y_true, proba, labels=[0, 1, 2]),\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "baseline_models = {\n",
    "    \"Dummy\": DummyClassifier(strategy=\"prior\", random_state=SEED),\n",
    "    \"Logistic\": LogisticRegression(max_iter=2500, class_weight=\"balanced\", random_state=SEED),\n",
    "    \"RandomForest\": RandomForestClassifier(\n",
    "        n_estimators=400, min_samples_leaf=4, class_weight=\"balanced_subsample\",\n",
    "        n_jobs=-1, random_state=SEED,\n",
    "    ),\n",
    "    \"HistGradientBoosting\": HistGradientBoostingClassifier(\n",
    "        max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31,\n",
    "        l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=SEED,\n",
    "    ),\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "validation_rows = []\n",
    "for name, estimator in baseline_models.items():\n",
    "    estimator.fit(X_train_t, y_train)\n",
    "    pred = estimator.predict(X_val_t)\n",
    "    proba = estimator.predict_proba(X_val_t)\n",
    "    validation_rows.append(evaluate_predictions(y_val, pred, proba, name, \"validation\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "validation_results = pd.DataFrame(validation_rows).sort_values(\"macro_f1\", ascending=False)\n",
    "display(validation_results)\n",
    "best_baseline_name = validation_results.iloc[0][\"model\"]\n",
    "best_baseline = baseline_models[best_baseline_name]\n",
    "joblib.dump(best_baseline, MODEL_DIR / \"best_baseline.joblib\")\n",
    "print(\"검증 Macro-F1 기준 최고 베이스라인:\", best_baseline_name)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "test_rows = []\n",
    "for name, estimator in baseline_models.items():\n",
    "    pred = estimator.predict(X_test_t)\n",
    "    proba = estimator.predict_proba(X_test_t)\n",
    "    test_rows.append(evaluate_predictions(y_test, pred, proba, name, \"test\"))\n",
    "\n",
    "model_comparison = pd.DataFrame(test_rows).sort_values(\"macro_f1\", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "display(model_comparison)\n",
    "\n",
    "best_test_pred = best_baseline.predict(X_test_t)\n",
    "print(classification_report(y_test, best_test_pred, target_names=CLASS_NAMES, digits=4))\n",
    "cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, best_test_pred, labels=[0, 1, 2])\n",
    "sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt=\"d\", cmap=\"Blues\", xticklabels=CLASS_NAMES, yticklabels=CLASS_NAMES)\n",
    "plt.title(f\"Best Baseline Confusion Matrix: {best_baseline_name}\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Predicted\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Actual\")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"baseline_confusion_matrix.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 6. PyTorch 심층신경망(MLP)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import torch\n",
    "from torch import nn\n",
    "from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.manual_seed(SEED)\n",
    "if torch.cuda.is_available():\n",
    "    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED)\n",
    "DEVICE = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
    "print(\"PyTorch:\", torch.__version__, \"| device:\", DEVICE)\n",
    "\n",
    "def make_loader(X, y, shuffle=False, batch_size=128):\n",
    "    dataset = TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32), torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.long))\n",
    "    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)\n",
    "    return DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=shuffle, num_workers=0, generator=generator)\n",
    "\n",
    "train_loader = make_loader(X_train_t, y_train, shuffle=True)\n",
    "val_loader = make_loader(X_val_t, y_val)\n",
    "\n",
    "class MatchMLP(nn.Module):\n",
    "    def __init__(self, input_dim, n_classes=3):\n",
    "        super().__init__()\n",
    "        self.network = nn.Sequential(\n",
    "            nn.Linear(input_dim, 128),\n",
    "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Dropout(0.25),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(128, 64),\n",
    "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Dropout(0.20),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(64, 32),\n",
    "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(32, n_classes),\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    def forward(self, x):\n",
    "        return self.network(x)\n",
    "\n",
    "match_mlp = MatchMLP(X_train_t.shape[1]).to(DEVICE)\n",
    "class_counts = np.bincount(y_train, minlength=3)\n",
    "class_weights = len(y_train) / (3.0 * class_counts)\n",
    "criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(weight=torch.tensor(class_weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE))\n",
    "optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(match_mlp.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)\n",
    "print(match_mlp)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def predict_torch(model, X, batch_size=512):\n",
    "    model.eval()\n",
    "    outputs = []\n",
    "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "        for start in range(0, len(X), batch_size):\n",
    "            xb = torch.tensor(X[start:start + batch_size], dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE)\n",
    "            outputs.append(torch.softmax(model(xb), dim=1).cpu().numpy())\n",
    "    return np.vstack(outputs)\n",
    "\n",
    "MAX_EPOCHS = 120\n",
    "PATIENCE = 15\n",
    "best_val_f1 = -np.inf\n",
    "best_state = None\n",
    "wait = 0\n",
    "history = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for epoch in range(1, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):\n",
    "    match_mlp.train()\n",
    "    total_loss = 0.0\n",
    "    for xb, yb in train_loader:\n",
    "        xb, yb = xb.to(DEVICE), yb.to(DEVICE)\n",
    "        optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
    "        logits = match_mlp(xb)\n",
    "        loss = criterion(logits, yb)\n",
    "        loss.backward()\n",
    "        optimizer.step()\n",
    "        total_loss += loss.item() * len(xb)\n",
    "\n",
    "    train_loss = total_loss / len(train_loader.dataset)\n",
    "    val_proba = predict_torch(match_mlp, X_val_t)\n",
    "    val_pred = val_proba.argmax(axis=1)\n",
    "    val_f1 = f1_score(y_val, val_pred, average=\"macro\")\n",
    "    history.append({\"epoch\": epoch, \"train_loss\": train_loss, \"val_macro_f1\": val_f1})\n",
    "\n",
    "    if val_f1 > best_val_f1 + 1e-4:\n",
    "        best_val_f1 = val_f1\n",
    "        best_state = copy.deepcopy(match_mlp.state_dict())\n",
    "        wait = 0\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        wait += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "    if epoch == 1 or epoch % 10 == 0:\n",
    "        print(f\"epoch={epoch:03d} train_loss={train_loss:.4f} val_macro_f1={val_f1:.4f}\")\n",
    "    if wait >= PATIENCE:\n",
    "        print(f\"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}\")\n",
    "        break\n",
    "\n",
    "match_mlp.load_state_dict(best_state)\n",
    "history_df = pd.DataFrame(history)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4))\n",
    "history_df.plot(x=\"epoch\", y=\"train_loss\", ax=axes[0], color=\"#D20515\", legend=False, title=\"MLP Train Loss\")\n",
    "history_df.plot(x=\"epoch\", y=\"val_macro_f1\", ax=axes[1], color=\"#1E3A5F\", legend=False, title=\"Validation Macro-F1\")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"mlp_training_history.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "print(\"Best validation Macro-F1:\", round(best_val_f1, 4))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "dl_proba = predict_torch(match_mlp, X_test_t)\n",
    "dl_pred = dl_proba.argmax(axis=1)\n",
    "dl_metrics = evaluate_predictions(y_test, dl_pred, dl_proba, \"PyTorch_MLP\", \"test\")\n",
    "model_comparison = pd.concat([model_comparison, pd.DataFrame([dl_metrics])], ignore_index=True)\n",
    "model_comparison = model_comparison.sort_values(\"macro_f1\", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "display(model_comparison)\n",
    "print(classification_report(y_test, dl_pred, target_names=CLASS_NAMES, digits=4))\n",
    "\n",
    "cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, dl_pred, labels=[0, 1, 2])\n",
    "sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt=\"d\", cmap=\"Reds\", xticklabels=CLASS_NAMES, yticklabels=CLASS_NAMES)\n",
    "plt.title(\"PyTorch MLP Confusion Matrix\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Predicted\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Actual\")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"mlp_confusion_matrix.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.save({\n",
    "    \"state_dict\": match_mlp.state_dict(),\n",
    "    \"input_dim\": X_train_t.shape[1],\n",
    "    \"class_names\": CLASS_NAMES.tolist(),\n",
    "    \"feature_names\": feature_names.tolist(),\n",
    "    \"best_val_macro_f1\": float(best_val_f1),\n",
    "}, MODEL_DIR / \"bundesliga_match_mlp.pt\")\n",
    "\n",
    "prediction_output = test_df[[\"match_id\", \"season\", \"match_date\", \"home_team\", \"away_team\", \"target_label\"]].copy()\n",
    "prediction_output[\"predicted_label\"] = CLASS_NAMES[dl_pred]\n",
    "for idx, class_name in enumerate(CLASS_NAMES):\n",
    "    prediction_output[f\"prob_{class_name.lower().replace(' ', '_')}\"] = dl_proba[:, idx]\n",
    "prediction_output.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"match_test_predictions.csv\", index=False, encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n",
    "model_comparison.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"model_comparison.csv\", index=False, encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 7. SHAP: 딥러닝 경기 결과 모델 설명\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import shap\n",
    "\n",
    "shap_success = False\n",
    "shap_importance = pd.DataFrame()\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    shap_model = copy.deepcopy(match_mlp).cpu().eval()\n",
    "    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)\n",
    "    background_idx = rng.choice(len(X_train_t), size=min(120, len(X_train_t)), replace=False)\n",
    "    explain_count = min(120, len(X_test_t))\n",
    "    background = torch.tensor(X_train_t[background_idx], dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "    explain_tensor = torch.tensor(X_test_t[:explain_count], dtype=torch.float32)\n",
    "\n",
    "    explainer = shap.DeepExplainer(shap_model, background)\n",
    "    try:\n",
    "        raw_shap = explainer.shap_values(explain_tensor, check_additivity=False)\n",
    "    except TypeError:\n",
    "        raw_shap = explainer.shap_values(explain_tensor)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def shap_for_class(values, class_idx):\n",
    "        if isinstance(values, list):\n",
    "            return np.asarray(values[class_idx])\n",
    "        arr = np.asarray(values)\n",
    "        if arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[-1] == 3:\n",
    "            return arr[:, :, class_idx]\n",
    "        if arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[0] == 3:\n",
    "            return arr[class_idx]\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"예상하지 못한 SHAP shape: {arr.shape}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    home_win_shap = shap_for_class(raw_shap, 2)\n",
    "    explain_np = explain_tensor.numpy()\n",
    "    shap_importance = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "        \"feature\": feature_names,\n",
    "        \"mean_abs_shap_home_win\": np.abs(home_win_shap).mean(axis=0),\n",
    "    }).sort_values(\"mean_abs_shap_home_win\", ascending=False)\n",
    "    shap_importance.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"shap_global_importance.csv\", index=False, encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n",
    "    display(shap_importance.head(20))\n",
    "\n",
    "    shap.summary_plot(home_win_shap, explain_np, feature_names=feature_names, max_display=20, show=False)\n",
    "    plt.title(\"PyTorch MLP SHAP — Home Win\")\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"shap_summary_home_win.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "    expected = np.asarray(explainer.expected_value)\n",
    "    base_value = float(expected[2] if expected.ndim else expected)\n",
    "    sample_idx = int(np.argmax(dl_proba[:explain_count, 2]))\n",
    "    explanation = shap.Explanation(\n",
    "        values=home_win_shap[sample_idx],\n",
    "        base_values=base_value,\n",
    "        data=explain_np[sample_idx],\n",
    "        feature_names=feature_names,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "    shap.plots.waterfall(explanation, max_display=15, show=False)\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"shap_waterfall_example.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "    print(\"설명 경기:\", test_df.iloc[sample_idx][[\"home_team\", \"away_team\", \"target_label\"]].to_dict())\n",
    "    shap_success = True\n",
    "except Exception as exc:\n",
    "    print(\"SHAP 계산이 중단되었습니다. 모델과 나머지 결과는 정상입니다.\")\n",
    "    print(type(exc).__name__, exc)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 8. 선수 BIS — 포지션별 투명 점수\n",
    "\n",
    "BIS는 정답 라벨이 아니라 **탐색용 지수**입니다.\n",
    "\n",
    "- 900분 이상 선수만 사용\n",
    "- 포지션 그룹 안에서 백분위 계산\n",
    "- 공격수·미드필더·수비수·골키퍼에 서로 다른 가중치 적용\n",
    "- 출전시간에 따른 신뢰도 보정값을 함께 제공\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "BIS_RULES = {\n",
    "    \"Forward\": {\n",
    "        \"goals_per90\": 0.28, \"assists_per90\": 0.17, \"shots_on_target_per90\": 0.14,\n",
    "        \"goal_contributions_per90\": 0.15, \"plus_minus_per90\": 0.10,\n",
    "        \"fouls_drawn_per90\": 0.08, \"tackles_won_per90\": 0.04, \"interceptions_per90\": 0.04,\n",
    "    },\n",
    "    \"Midfielder\": {\n",
    "        \"assists_per90\": 0.18, \"goal_contributions_per90\": 0.16, \"crosses_per90\": 0.14,\n",
    "        \"tackles_won_per90\": 0.13, \"interceptions_per90\": 0.13, \"plus_minus_per90\": 0.12,\n",
    "        \"shots_on_target_per90\": 0.07, \"fouls_drawn_per90\": 0.07,\n",
    "    },\n",
    "    \"Defender\": {\n",
    "        \"tackles_won_per90\": 0.23, \"interceptions_per90\": 0.23, \"plus_minus_per90\": 0.18,\n",
    "        \"crosses_per90\": 0.08, \"goal_contributions_per90\": 0.08,\n",
    "        \"fouls_drawn_per90\": 0.06, \"fouls_committed_per90\": -0.08, \"red_cards\": -0.06,\n",
    "    },\n",
    "    \"Goalkeeper\": {\n",
    "        \"save_pct_gk\": 0.36, \"clean_sheet_pct_gk\": 0.30,\n",
    "        \"goals_against_per90_gk\": -0.24, \"plus_minus_per90\": 0.10,\n",
    "    },\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "player_bis = players_900.copy()\n",
    "player_bis[\"bis_raw\"] = np.nan\n",
    "\n",
    "for position, rules in BIS_RULES.items():\n",
    "    mask = player_bis[\"position_group\"].eq(position)\n",
    "    subset = player_bis.loc[mask]\n",
    "    if subset.empty:\n",
    "        continue\n",
    "    score = pd.Series(0.0, index=subset.index)\n",
    "    abs_weight = sum(abs(w) for w in rules.values())\n",
    "    for metric, weight in rules.items():\n",
    "        values = pd.to_numeric(subset[metric], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
    "        values = values.fillna(values.median())\n",
    "        percentile = values.rank(pct=True, method=\"average\")\n",
    "        if weight < 0:\n",
    "            percentile = (-values).rank(pct=True, method=\"average\")\n",
    "        score += abs(weight) / abs_weight * percentile\n",
    "    player_bis.loc[mask, \"bis_raw\"] = 100 * score\n",
    "\n",
    "player_bis[\"bis_reliability\"] = (player_bis[\"minutes\"] / 1800).clip(upper=1.0)\n",
    "player_bis[\"bis_score\"] = 50 + (player_bis[\"bis_raw\"] - 50) * player_bis[\"bis_reliability\"]\n",
    "player_bis[\"bis_position_rank\"] = (\n",
    "    player_bis.groupby(\"position_group\")[\"bis_score\"].rank(method=\"min\", ascending=False).astype(int)\n",
    ")\n",
    "player_bis[\"bis_version\"] = \"v1_position_percentile_900min\"\n",
    "player_bis = player_bis.sort_values([\"position_group\", \"bis_position_rank\", \"minutes\"])\n",
    "player_bis.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"player_bis_2025_26.csv\", index=False, encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n",
    "\n",
    "display(player_bis.groupby(\"position_group\", group_keys=False).head(10)[[\n",
    "    \"position_group\", \"bis_position_rank\", \"player\", \"club\", \"minutes\", \"bis_raw\", \"bis_score\", \"bis_reliability\"\n",
    "]])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 9. 선수 유형 군집화\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "PLAYER_STYLE_FEATURES = [\n",
    "    \"goals_per90\", \"assists_per90\", \"shots_per90\", \"shots_on_target_per90\",\n",
    "    \"crosses_per90\", \"tackles_won_per90\", \"interceptions_per90\",\n",
    "    \"fouls_drawn_per90\", \"plus_minus_per90\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "field_players = player_bis[~player_bis[\"is_goalkeeper\"]].copy().reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "style_imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy=\"median\")\n",
    "style_scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
    "style_values = style_imputer.fit_transform(field_players[PLAYER_STYLE_FEATURES])\n",
    "style_scaled = style_scaler.fit_transform(style_values)\n",
    "\n",
    "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=5, n_init=30, random_state=SEED)\n",
    "field_players[\"style_cluster\"] = kmeans.fit_predict(style_scaled)\n",
    "pca = PCA(n_components=2, random_state=SEED)\n",
    "pca_values = pca.fit_transform(style_scaled)\n",
    "field_players[\"pca_1\"] = pca_values[:, 0]\n",
    "field_players[\"pca_2\"] = pca_values[:, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "cluster_profile = pd.DataFrame(style_scaled, columns=PLAYER_STYLE_FEATURES).assign(\n",
    "    style_cluster=field_players[\"style_cluster\"].to_numpy()\n",
    ").groupby(\"style_cluster\").mean()\n",
    "cluster_profile[\"cluster_name\"] = cluster_profile.apply(\n",
    "    lambda row: \" + \".join(row.drop(\"cluster_name\", errors=\"ignore\").nlargest(2).index).replace(\"_per90\", \"\"), axis=1\n",
    ")\n",
    "field_players[\"cluster_name\"] = field_players[\"style_cluster\"].map(cluster_profile[\"cluster_name\"])\n",
    "display(cluster_profile)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(11, 7))\n",
    "sns.scatterplot(data=field_players, x=\"pca_1\", y=\"pca_2\", hue=\"cluster_name\", style=\"primary_position\", s=70)\n",
    "plt.title(\"2025/26 Bundesliga Field Player Style Clusters\")\n",
    "plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc=\"upper left\")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"player_style_clusters.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "joblib.dump(style_imputer, MODEL_DIR / \"player_style_imputer.joblib\")\n",
    "joblib.dump(style_scaler, MODEL_DIR / \"player_style_scaler.joblib\")\n",
    "joblib.dump(kmeans, MODEL_DIR / \"player_style_kmeans.joblib\")\n",
    "cluster_profile.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"player_cluster_profiles.csv\", encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 10. 딥러닝 오토인코더 — 선수 임베딩과 유사 선수\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "class PlayerAutoencoder(nn.Module):\n",
    "    def __init__(self, input_dim, latent_dim=3):\n",
    "        super().__init__()\n",
    "        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(\n",
    "            nn.Linear(input_dim, 16), nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(16, 8), nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(8, latent_dim),\n",
    "        )\n",
    "        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(\n",
    "            nn.Linear(latent_dim, 8), nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(8, 16), nn.ReLU(),\n",
    "            nn.Linear(16, input_dim),\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    def forward(self, x):\n",
    "        z = self.encoder(x)\n",
    "        return self.decoder(z)\n",
    "\n",
    "ae_data = torch.tensor(style_scaled, dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE)\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)\n",
    "order = rng.permutation(len(ae_data))\n",
    "cut = int(len(order) * 0.80)\n",
    "train_idx, val_idx = order[:cut], order[cut:]\n",
    "train_idx_t = torch.tensor(train_idx, dtype=torch.long, device=DEVICE)\n",
    "val_idx_t = torch.tensor(val_idx, dtype=torch.long, device=DEVICE)\n",
    "ae_train = ae_data[train_idx_t]\n",
    "ae_val = ae_data[val_idx_t]\n",
    "\n",
    "autoencoder = PlayerAutoencoder(len(PLAYER_STYLE_FEATURES), latent_dim=3).to(DEVICE)\n",
    "ae_optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(autoencoder.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-5)\n",
    "ae_loss_fn = nn.MSELoss()\n",
    "best_ae_state, best_ae_loss, ae_wait = None, np.inf, 0\n",
    "ae_history = []\n",
    "\n",
    "for epoch in range(1, 501):\n",
    "    autoencoder.train()\n",
    "    ae_optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
    "    noisy = ae_train + 0.05 * torch.randn_like(ae_train)\n",
    "    train_loss = ae_loss_fn(autoencoder(noisy), ae_train)\n",
    "    train_loss.backward()\n",
    "    ae_optimizer.step()\n",
    "\n",
    "    autoencoder.eval()\n",
    "    with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "        val_loss = ae_loss_fn(autoencoder(ae_val), ae_val).item()\n",
    "    ae_history.append({\"epoch\": epoch, \"train_loss\": train_loss.item(), \"val_loss\": val_loss})\n",
    "\n",
    "    if val_loss < best_ae_loss - 1e-5:\n",
    "        best_ae_loss = val_loss\n",
    "        best_ae_state = copy.deepcopy(autoencoder.state_dict())\n",
    "        ae_wait = 0\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        ae_wait += 1\n",
    "    if epoch % 50 == 0:\n",
    "        print(f\"epoch={epoch:03d} train_mse={train_loss.item():.5f} val_mse={val_loss:.5f}\")\n",
    "    if ae_wait >= 40:\n",
    "        print(\"Autoencoder early stopping:\", epoch)\n",
    "        break\n",
    "\n",
    "autoencoder.load_state_dict(best_ae_state)\n",
    "autoencoder.eval()\n",
    "with torch.no_grad():\n",
    "    embeddings = autoencoder.encoder(ae_data).cpu().numpy()\n",
    "for i in range(embeddings.shape[1]):\n",
    "    field_players[f\"latent_{i+1}\"] = embeddings[:, i]\n",
    "\n",
    "similarity = cosine_similarity(embeddings)\n",
    "def similar_players(player_name: str, top_n=5):\n",
    "    candidates = field_players.index[field_players[\"player\"].str.casefold().eq(player_name.casefold())].tolist()\n",
    "    if not candidates:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(f\"선수를 찾을 수 없습니다: {player_name}\")\n",
    "    idx = candidates[0]\n",
    "    same_position = field_players.index[field_players[\"primary_position\"].eq(field_players.loc[idx, \"primary_position\"])].to_numpy()\n",
    "    ranked = same_position[np.argsort(similarity[idx, same_position])[::-1]]\n",
    "    ranked = [i for i in ranked if i != idx][:top_n]\n",
    "    result = field_players.loc[ranked, [\"player\", \"club\", \"primary_position\", \"bis_score\", \"cluster_name\"]].copy()\n",
    "    result.insert(0, \"query_player\", field_players.loc[idx, \"player\"])\n",
    "    result[\"similarity\"] = [similarity[idx, i] for i in ranked]\n",
    "    return result\n",
    "\n",
    "example_player = field_players.sort_values(\"bis_score\", ascending=False).iloc[0][\"player\"]\n",
    "example_similar = similar_players(example_player, top_n=5)\n",
    "display(example_similar)\n",
    "\n",
    "scouting_ready = player_bis.merge(\n",
    "    field_players[[\"player_club_id\", \"style_cluster\", \"cluster_name\", \"pca_1\", \"pca_2\", \"latent_1\", \"latent_2\", \"latent_3\"]],\n",
    "    on=\"player_club_id\", how=\"left\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "scouting_ready.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"player_scouting_ready.csv\", index=False, encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n",
    "example_similar.to_csv(OUTPUT_DIR / \"similar_players_example.csv\", index=False, encoding=\"utf-8-sig\")\n",
    "\n",
    "torch.save({\n",
    "    \"state_dict\": autoencoder.state_dict(),\n",
    "    \"input_dim\": len(PLAYER_STYLE_FEATURES),\n",
    "    \"latent_dim\": 3,\n",
    "    \"features\": PLAYER_STYLE_FEATURES,\n",
    "    \"best_val_mse\": float(best_ae_loss),\n",
    "}, MODEL_DIR / \"player_autoencoder.pt\")\n",
    "\n",
    "ae_history_df = pd.DataFrame(ae_history)\n",
    "ae_history_df.plot(x=\"epoch\", y=[\"train_loss\", \"val_loss\"], figsize=(10, 4), title=\"Player Autoencoder Reconstruction Loss\")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig(FIGURE_DIR / \"autoencoder_training_history.png\", dpi=160, bbox_inches=\"tight\")\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },

    "## 최종 해석 기준\n",
    "\n",
    "- **가장 중요한 성능 기준:** 테스트 `Macro-F1`과 `Log loss`\n",
    "- 무승부는 본질적으로 어려운 클래스이므로 Accuracy만 보면 안 됩니다.\n",
    "- 딥러닝이 베이스라인보다 낮게 나와도 오류가 아닙니다. 7,650행 규모의 표형 데이터에서는 로지스틱·트리 모델이 더 강할 수 있습니다.\n",
    "- BIS는 실제 시장가치나 감독 평가의 정답이 아니라 탐색용 상대지수입니다.\n",
    "- 유사 선수는 900분 이상 필드플레이어의 경기 스타일 통계로 학습한 잠재공간 기준입니다.\n",
    "- Streamlit 화면에는 모델 성능, 테스트 기간, 900분 기준, BIS 가중치 버전을 반드시 표시하세요.\n",
    "\n",
